## About

Yum News publishes practical, step-by-step guides for Android, Gemini AI, Firebase, Claude, Google Home, and developer tooling. Coverage focuses on useful product workflows — from consumer Android features to SDK-level APIs and AI integrations. Articles are written for developers, makers, and technically curious readers.

- **Android Apps & Updates** — Android 17, One UI 9, Galaxy S26 rollout, Pixel drops, Pixel VIP widgets, Pixel 11 Magic Capture, Pixel Scam Detection, Pixel Now Playing notifications, Pixel Watch one-handed gestures, Gboard Rambler, Gboard warnings, Motion Assist, Find Hub Remembered items, AndroidX Security State, Circle to Search, Google Messages Keep notes, Gmail Copy code 2FA, Google Authenticator transfer, new OS features, ADB, debugging, Android CLI, Media3 MiniController, Android Bench 2.0, Create My Widget, Gemini Intelligence, Google Finance Android app, BOOX Android 16 E Ink (Palma 3, Note Air6 C, Note Mini C), Google Home Favorites widget

  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/google-authenticator-transfer-new-phone/
  Sync Authenticator with a Google Account or export QR codes from the old phone and import them on the new Android or iPhone before you factory-reset.

  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/google-home-widget-battery/
  Add the Favorites widget on Android 12+ or iOS 17+, choose tiles, and use the 16 September 2026 Home update that pauses widget polling when the screen is off.

- How to Turn Off Smart TV ACR and Viewing Data Collection
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/smart-tv-disable-acr-tracking/
  Disable Automatic Content Recognition on Samsung, LG, Sony, Vizio, Hisense, and Roku TVs. Find Viewing Information Services, Live Plus, and Viewing Data toggles.

- How to Use Pixel Watch One-Handed Gestures After the September 2026 Drop
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/pixel-watch-one-handed-gestures/
  Set up double-pinch, wrist-turn back, and Raise to Talk on Pixel Watch 3 and newer. Open notifications, scroll Gemini, and navigate Maps without a second hand.
